essence: Twirl remaps pixels by rotating them around a chosen center, with the rotational displacement fading from strongest near the center to zero at the Twirl Radius boundary. Angle sets how much the image is wound or unwound; Radius limits the affected region; Center chooses the pivot.
manifests_as: A circular area of the image appears twisted into a spiral around a pivot, while pixels outside the radius remain unchanged.

key_levers.name: Angle
key_levers.effect: Sets the amount and direction of rotational pixel displacement around the center; larger absolute values create a tighter, more obvious spiral.

key_levers.name: Twirl Radius
key_levers.effect: Sets the size of the circular region that receives the twirl; increasing it spreads the twist farther from the center.

key_levers.name: Twirl Center
key_levers.effect: Moves the pivot and the center of the affected circular region; place it on the feature meant to become the vortex.

key_levers.name: Effect Opacity
key_levers.effect: Blends the twirled result with the original layer; lower values soften or partially remove the distortion without changing its geometry.

enums_to_verify.GPU Rendering (ADBE Force CPU GPU, 1-3): Unverified: likely selects automatic/CPU/GPU rendering behavior rather than a creative visual mode; verify value labels in this AE build.

config_recipes.subtle localized twist: Angle 25 degrees; Twirl Radius 25; Twirl Center on the detail to bend; Effect Opacity 100%.
config_recipes.obvious vortex: Angle 180 degrees; Twirl Radius 70; Twirl Center on the vortex target; Effect Opacity 100%.
config_recipes.soft warped accent: Angle 90 degrees; Twirl Radius 45; Twirl Center on the subject; Effect Opacity 45%.

reasoning_hooks: Angle at its default of 0 produces no visible twirl even when Radius and Center are set.
Radius is the boundary of the affected area: moving the Center changes where that boundary lands, so set Center on the subject before judging Radius.
Effect Opacity only mixes the finished distortion back toward the source; it does not reduce the Angle or shrink the affected region.
Animate Angle when the twist needs to evolve over time; animate Center when the vortex must track a moving feature.
